title: 第863章 兴许没失忆第862章 是有什么
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
林蔓当即清楚发生了什么事情，脸色大变，“柳思哲太过分了，这么欺负你。”
许雾一把拉住林蔓的手，“跟他没关系，那种事情其实也是你情我愿。”
万韵诗也摁住林蔓的手，拍了拍，“这种事情没法说，你冷静点。”
林蔓的确是激动了。
她发自内心地心疼许雾，此时满眼忧心地看着她，
“那你现在是怎么想的？”
许雾轻摇了摇头：，“我只想好好地工作，其他东西都不想，尤其是和柳总之间的关系。”
许雾低着头，深吸了口气，“你们相信我，从来没有想过要破坏他们两个的关系，而且……”
许雾欲言又止。
林蔓一把握紧了她的手，
“我当然相信你，你就不是那样的人。”
“再者说，沈梦樱和柳思哲根本就没在一起，你和他之间的事情，跟沈梦樱什么关系？”
万韵诗打了个响指，“bingo！我就是这么想的。”
“三年前的情侣关系，三年后就算想继续，也要得到老柳的同意。很显然，老柳根本就不想跟她在一起。”
万韵诗和林蔓的话，给了许雾一点心理安慰。
许雾的眼珠子在他们两个人脸上来回转动，询问着内心的不安。
“我这样真的不算做错事吗？”
林蔓想都没想，“当然不算。韵诗姐不是都说了吗？三年前的关系跟三年后有什么关系。”
万韵诗道：“你这个人就是太老实了，人家说什么你就听什么，你就不会怼回去吗？”
许雾磕巴道：“因为我觉得自己做错了。”

“你才是最单纯的那个。”万韵诗笑着拍拍她的脑袋。
林蔓的神色微微沉了下去，“我总觉得沈梦樱不简单。”
林蔓琢磨着用词，心里想到梁音，所以说话略微有些顾忌。
万韵诗眯着眼，朝餐厅的柳思哲看去。
柳思哲还在跟他们喝酒，但时不时会朝这边看一眼。
刚好万韵诗看过去的同时，他的目光也朝这边看过来，两人正好对视上。
万韵诗想要把那些事说出来的冲动又摁了回去——
没辙，她答应了柳思哲，暂时不说那些事。
朋友之间到底要讲义气。
当然万韵诗也不可能什么都不说。
她暗示开口，“兴许她根本就没失忆呢？又或者她有什么东西在骗着你们。”
林蔓瞪大了眼，“我觉得真有可能。”
许雾难以置信，“不会吧？韵诗姐，她为什么要这样？”
“为什么要这样？”
林蔓眼神恢复了以往的张扬锐利，“想知道查一查不就知道了。”
万韵诗第一个赞同。
许雾犹犹豫豫的也点了下头。
content_en:
Lin Man immediately understood what happened, and his expression changed drastically, "Liu Sizhe went too far, bullying you like this."
Xu Wu took Lin Man's hand and said, "It has nothing to do with him. That kind of thing is actually a matter of mutual consent."
Wan Yunshi also held Lin Man's hand and patted it, "You can't talk about this kind of thing, please calm down."
Lin Man was indeed excited.
She felt sorry for Xu Wu from the bottom of her heart and looked at her with worried eyes.
"Then what do you think now?"
Xu Wu shook his head lightly: "I just want to work hard and don't think about anything else, especially the relationship with Mr. Liu."
Xu Wu lowered his head and took a deep breath, "Believe me, I never thought of destroying their relationship, and..."
Xu Wu hesitated to speak.
Lin Man tightened her hand,
"Of course I believe you, you're not that kind of person."
"Besides, Shen Mengying and Liu Sizhe are not together at all. What does the matter between you and him have to do with Shen Mengying?"
Wan Yunshi snapped her fingers, "bingo! That's what I thought."
"Even if you want to continue the relationship three years ago, you have to get Lao Liu's consent. Obviously, Lao Liu doesn't want to be with her at all."
Wan Yunshi and Lin Man's words gave Xu Wu some psychological comfort.
Xu Wu's eyes moved back and forth on their faces, questioning their inner uneasiness.
"Does this really not mean I did something wrong?"
Lin Man didn't even think about it, "Of course not. Didn't Sister Yunshi tell you everything? What does the relationship three years ago have to do with three years later?"
Wan Yunshi said: "You are too honest. You just listen to what others say, so you won't fight back?"
Xu Wu stuttered: "Because I think I did something wrong."
"You are the most innocent one." Wan Yunshi smiled and patted her head.
Lin Man's expression darkened slightly, "I always feel that Shen Mengying is not simple."
Lin Man thought about the words and thought of Liang Yin, so she was a little hesitant to speak.
Wan Yunshi squinted and looked towards Liu Sizhe in the restaurant.
Liu Sizhe was still drinking with them, but he would glance here from time to time.
Just as Wan Yunshi looked over, he also looked over here, and the two happened to look at each other.
Wan Yunshi suppressed the urge to tell those things -
No choice, she promised Liu Sizhe not to talk about those things for the time being.
There must be loyalty between friends.
Of course, it is impossible for Wan Yun Shi to say nothing.
She hinted, "Maybe she doesn't have amnesia at all? Or maybe she's lying to you about something."
Lin Man's eyes widened, "I think it's really possible."
Xu Wu couldn't believe it, "No way? Sister Yunshi, why is she like this?"
"Why is this happening?"
Lin Man's eyes returned to their usual bold and sharp look, "I wonder if I can find out if I check."
Wan Yunshi was the first to agree.
Xu Wu nodded hesitantly.
